meta.title: Fees and payment
meta.description: Registration fee and school fees at Collège Tomi Fidele by level, instalment schedule, fee calculator and payment by MTN Mobile Money, Orange Money or at the school office.

hero.title: Fees and {payment}
hero.intro: School fees by level, the instalment schedule, the fee calculator and the payment methods.

registration.title: Registration fee
registration.new: Paid once, on first enrolment at the school. [To be confirmed by the school.]

grid.title: School fees by {level}
grid.intro: School fees are paid in %count% instalments. Amounts are in CFA francs.

simulator.title: Work out the fees for {your child}
simulator.intro: Choose the section, stream and class: the calculator shows the instalment schedule and the total for the year.
simulator.pending: The amounts have not been published yet. The calculator will do the sums as soon as the school provides them.
simulator.disclaimer: This is an estimate: only the school's official fee schedule is binding.

payment.title: How to {pay} school fees
payment.intro: Always give the student's name and class, and keep the confirmation message.
steps: Enter the school's number and the instalment amount.
Check the account name before confirming.
Send the confirmation to the school office, with the student's name and class.

cash.title: At the school office
cash.label: Cash desk hours
steps: Come with the student's name and class.
Keep the receipt given by the school.

warning.title: Before confirming a transfer
warning.text: Check that the name shown on your phone is the school's. If you have any doubt about a number, call the school office before paying.
